scripts.dev:all: concurrently --names "setup,frontend" --prefix-colors "blue,cyan" --kill-others "npm run dev:setup" "cd frontend && npm run dev:ssr"
scripts.dev:frontend: cd frontend && tsc --noEmit && npm run dev:ssr
scripts.install:all: concurrently --names "frontend,backend" --prefix-colors "cyan,yellow" "cd frontend && npm install" "cd backend && composer install"
scripts.dev:backend: concurrently --names "artisan,queue" --prefix-colors "magenta,green" --kill-others "cd backend && php artisan serve" "cd backend && php artisan queue:listen"
scripts.dev:full: concurrently --names "frontend,artisan,queue" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta,green" --kill-others "cd frontend && npm run dev:ssr" "cd backend && php artisan serve" "cd backend && php artisan queue:listen"
scripts.migrate:fresh: cd backend && php artisan migrate:fresh && php artisan generate-domain-objects
